title: Rescene: stable century-long climate emulation from a frozen weather model
abstract: arXiv:2608.09971v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Machine-learning weather models now match or exceed operational numerical prediction in the medium range, but when they are run freely for years they drift, blow up or lose their variability, and dedicated climate emulators are expensive to train. Here we present Rescene, a 0.4 M-parameter wrapper that turns a frozen 1.5$^\circ$, 6-hourly, 69-variable weather model into a stochastic climate emulator. A deterministic slow clock anchors the frozen model to a calendar climatology, and a band-limited AR(1) perturbation, whose spectral envelope is fixed to the observed anomaly spectrum, restores the weather that anchoring removes. A 100-year, 8-member Rescene run shows no detectable drift ($-0.004 \pm 0.014$ K per 100 years), and on the 2022 test year the 16-member ensemble is calibrated (spread/skill 0.89, 0.97 and 0.93 for Z500, T2m and MSLP) with an extratropical synoptic amplitude of 97% of ERA5 on the tuning year. translated_title: Rescene：基于冻结天气模型的稳定百年气候模拟
translated_abstract: 机器学习天气模型如今在中期预报中已能匹敌甚至超越业务数值预报，但当它们自由运行多年时会出现漂移、发散或失去变率，而专门的气候模拟器训练成本高昂。我们提出Rescene，一个仅0.4M参数的轻量封装器，可将一个冻结的1.5°分辨率、6小时步长、69变量天气模型转化为随机气候模拟器。一个确定性的慢时钟将冻结模型锚定于日历气候态，而一个带限AR(1)扰动（其谱包络固定于观测到的异常谱）则恢复锚定过程所移除的天气变化。一次100年、8成员的Rescene运行未显示出可检测的漂移（每100年−0.004 ± 0.014 K）；在2022年测试年上，16成员集合被良好校准（Z500、T2m和MSLP的离散度/技巧比分别为0.89、0.97和0.93），且其温带天气振幅在调参年达到ERA5的97%。
tldr: Rescene仅用一个0.4M参数的轻量封装，将冻结的机器学习天气模型转化为可稳定运行百年、无漂移且变率得到良好校准的随机气候模拟器。
en_tdlr: Rescene uses a lightweight 0.4M-parameter wrapper to turn a frozen machine-learning weather model into a stochastic climate emulator that runs stably for a century without detectable drift while preserving well-calibrated variability.
